title: Patch: a Cloaked Spell dropped outside the backrow zones casts face-up at once
thread:
**Issue #5107 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #5107: Patch: a Cloaked Spell dropped outside the backrow zones casts face-up at once
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

When you drag a Cloaked Spell out of your hand (printed Cloaked, given by a Buff, or lent by M #99 Paranoia's Aura: §6.1 Cloaked, R783004, R783007, R2727000), its open backrow zones light up, since setting it face-down is one of its legal plays. Today, dropping it anywhere else on the board does nothing: the card goes back to the hand, and the only way to cast it face-up is to click it and answer the **"Play it how?"** prompt (Face-up / Cloaked). That's a lot of steps when you just want to cast the spell.

**Change:** dropping a Cloaked Spell on the board, but **outside** the highlighted backrow zones, casts it **face-up** right away, the same as a drop casts a Spell that has no Cloaked. Dropping it **on** a highlighted backrow zone still sets it face-down, as it does now. Clicking the card still opens the "Play it how?" picker as it does now.

This is client-only (CLAUDE.md rule 7). The engine already lists the face-up play, so the client just has to pick it. No engine, card or AI change.

### Where it goes wrong

`apps/web/src/game/drag/model.ts`, `planPlay`:

```ts
const dropTestids = dropSetFor(view, legal, lifted);
const freeDrop = dropTestids.size === 0 || outstandingNeed(lifted) === null;
```

For an untargeted Cloaked Spell, `dropTestids` holds the backrow zones of the set plays, and `outstandingNeed(lifted)` returns the `faceDown` need (`actions.ts`, "ME-ALTPLAY: how it is played is asked before anything else"). So `freeDrop` is false, and `resolveDrop` treats a board drop as a miss. Yet `resolveDrop` already says "ME-ALTPLAY: a free drop casts face-up" and picks `{ faceDown: "up" }`. That path just never runs when set plays are present. The arrow logic in the same function already skips set candidates (`if (candidate.faceDown !== undefined) continue;`). `freeDrop` should follow the same rule: it should be decided by the **face-up** candidates alone. If those would be a free drop (no zone and no targets for a face-up play), a board drop is free, and the backrow zones stay in `dropTestids` so they still set the card.

After a board drop picks face-up, any need the face-up play still has (X, embiggen, Plague Counters, modes) is asked as usual through the picker, the same as for a non-Cloaked Spell.

### Out of scope / should still work

- A **targeted** Cloaked Spell keeps the arrow (test "R1044 a targeted spell that may also be set face-down still draws the arrow"): a drop on a target casts it face-up, and a drop on a backrow zone sets it. Check that this still passes, and that a drop on empty board space with an arrow is still a miss.
- A Cloaked **Unit** or **Field Spell** whose face-up play needs a zone: its own zones already take the face-up drop. Leave it as it is unless the same `freeDrop` fix covers it for free.
- The click path and the "Play it how?" prompt (`Prompt.tsx`, `case "faceDown"`) stay as they are.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `apps/web/src/game/drag/model.test.ts`: for an untargeted Spell whose legal plays are face-up plus a `faceDown: "cloaked"` set into backrow zones, `planDrag` gives `freeDrop: true`, `arrow: false`, and `dropTestids` still lists the backrow zones.
- [ ] `resolveDrop` for that plan with `{ at: "board" }` sends the face-up `play` (no `faceDown`, no zone). With a backrow zone as the target, it sends the `cloaked` set into that zone.
- [ ] A Cloaked Spell with X (or modes) dropped on the board skips the face-up/set question and goes straight to the X/mode picker.
- [ ] The existing R1044 targeted-arrow test and the other `model.test.ts` / `DragLayer.test.tsx` / `Prompt.test.tsx` cases stay green.
- [ ] If the builder treats this as a ruling the spec doesn't make yet (a drag-drop rule for alternative plays), it adds a note in this issue's R-block with a proving `it("R<n> …")` test, and puts its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/drag`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` pass.

## Links

None blocking. Background: #781 / #783 (Cloaked), R658 and B34 (drag-to-play, free drops).
````
